server.name: Saucin RP
server.slogan: Where grinders, creatives, and criminals collide.
server.description: Saucin RP is a custom FiveM roleplay server built for story-driven, serious and semi-serious roleplay. Dive into a fully customized city with unique scripts, whitelisted careers, gangs, events, and an active staff team that actually cares. Whether you’re law enforcement, EMS, criminal, or civilian, your choices shape the streets and your story in Saucin RP.

Build your legacy, one choice at a time

rules.title: Active Development & Compensation
rules.description: Saucin RP is an active development project. Compensation is only issued when losses can be verified and is not guaranteed for crashes or dev issues.

rules.title: Community Conduct
rules.description: No racism, sexism, harassment, bullying, toxicity, trolling, or real-money trading. Respect the community both in and out of roleplay.

rules.title: 18+ & Mic Required
rules.description: All players must be 18+ with a clear, working microphone for voice-based roleplay.

rules.title: Recording Software Required
rules.description: Recording software (e.g., Medal, Shadowplay) is required. Clips older than 48 hours are not valid for reports or reimbursements.

rules.title: Realistic Character Names
rules.description: Character names must be realistic. No celebrity names, joke names, or controversial figures.

rules.title: No Exploiting or Cheating
rules.description: No exploiting, cheating, hiding exploits, or using unfair graphics mods, crosshairs, or tools that give a competitive advantage.

rules.title: No External Communication
rules.description: You may not be in Discord calls or similar external comms while in the city, even if muted or deafened.

rules.title: No Metagaming
rules.description: Do not use information your character wouldn’t reasonably know, including Discord, streams, or knowledge from other characters.

rules.title: No Powergaming
rules.description: Do not force outcomes, abuse mechanics, or deny others a fair chance to react. Give reasonable time and keep actions realistic.

rules.title: No FailRP
rules.description: Stay in character, avoid low-effort or troll RP, and follow medical, vehicle, and scene realism guidelines at all times.

rules.title: Value Your Life
rules.description: Treat life-threatening situations seriously, avoid unrealistic hero behavior, and properly roleplay injuries and consequences.

rules.title: No Combat Logging or Invalid Respawns
rules.description: Do not log out or respawn to avoid RP or consequences. Never return after a full death unless allowed by staff.

rules.title: Prohibited Roleplay
rules.description: Rape, extreme torture, terrorism, racist roleplay, and injury RP involving genital or rear extremities are strictly forbidden.

rules.title: No Asset Dumping
rules.description: Giving away large amounts of items, money, or vehicles when leaving the server or retiring a character is not allowed.

rules.title: Random Deathmatch (RDM)
rules.description: You must have clear RP build-up and reasoning before killing someone. Random or low-effort kills are not allowed.

rules.title: Vehicle Deathmatch (VDM)
rules.description: Vehicles are not weapons. Using them to intentionally run over or ram players is only allowed as an absolute last resort.

rules.title: Green Zones
rules.description: Spawn, hospitals, fire stations, and large public/business gatherings are passive RP only. No violence or criminal RP in these areas.

rules.title: Criminal RP Quality
rules.description: Criminal RP must be story-driven, not constant shootouts or low-effort crime. Max 10 criminals per scene and no targeting AFK players.

rules.title: Respect EMS & SAFR
rules.description: EMS and SAFR may not be harmed, looted, or taken unless explicitly allowed by specific scenarios (e.g., TEMS).

rules.title: Robbery Rules
rules.description: Rob within proper RP build-up. Certain items (phone, ID, licenses, basic food/water, radios) cannot be taken, and you cannot rob on-duty officers.

rules.title: Kidnapping & Hostage Rules
rules.description: Hostages have time limits, may not be reused repeatedly, and law enforcement/EMS hostage situations must meet population and RP standards.

rules.title: Scamming Rules
rules.description: You may not scam players out of items, vehicles, or property. Scamming is limited to information such as locations or processes.

rules.title: Heists & Location Robberies
rules.description: Heists must be run for RP, not just ambushing cops. There are limits on vehicles and expectations for fair, visible engagements.

rules.title: Gang Taxing & Civ Interactions
rules.description: Gangs may tax civs reasonably but may not rob, wallet-wipe, or grief them. Most conflict should be between gangs, not random civilians.

rules.title: Gang Escalation & War
rules.description: Gang conflict follows the in-game 7-day escalation system using rcore gangs and Wasabi war phone. Ambush RP and cheap-shot PvP are forbidden.

rules.title: Business Ownership
rules.description: Business owners must remain active, follow economic and RP standards, and may lose ownership for inactivity or abuse.

rules.title: DHS & Staff
rules.description: DHS uniforms represent staff. Do not steal, damage, or impersonate DHS vehicles or gear. Treat interactions as IC unless told otherwise.

rules.title: Reporting Players
rules.description: Use /report or Discord tickets with at least 2 minutes of footage. False or troll reports, or lying to DHS, are punishable.

rules.title: Airsoft & Replica Weapons
rules.description: Brandishing or firing airsoft/replica weapons at officers is strictly prohibited and carries severe penalties, including long-term bans.

rules.title: No Stream Sniping
rules.description: Using streams or external content to track or counter players is treated as metagaming and will be punished.
